notes.title: Update 4.0 - Code Rework + New Tutorial
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/52a7572e1b25e11be64d4056129bd1e911f0b943.png[/img]
[h1]Buckle up for Update 4.0![/h1]
Version number updates usually mean big changes incoming! There is a lot to note for this one.
Goose Goose Duck is turning 4 this year! Over the years, the team has been adding A LOT of content: 12 maps, 10 gamemodes, over 70 roles, and of course a TON of cosmetics to collect! Not only is that a lot of content but a lot of behind-the-scenes work as well, so it's good to go back once in a while and tidy things up a little to be able to keep adding content with as few hiccups as possible. In addition to the code rework, let's discuss some of the notable additions.

[b]DISCLAIMER:[/b] With major code reworks, bugs and unintended features may turn up despite the amount of rigorous testing the amazing beta testers perform. If you experience a bug or unintended feature, please report them using the in-game bug report section found in Settings or fill out an [url="https://gagglestudios.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new"]online ticket form[/url]. 

[h2]Tutorial[/h2]The tutorial section has been updated! We've improved the appearance as well as updated the Goose and Duck Tutorials to help explain how to play.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/e8fa617c41d02e896e13fd61c98ceea958d33637.png[/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/d45012cf315b105da062245b0b93e5963e8c8fee.png"][/img]

[h2]In-Game HUD[/h2]
Updated the In-Game HUD visually; combining the role indicator with the duties list. The role indicator now acts as a button to quickly open information regarding your current role. With that additional space at the top of the screen, what should we do with it?

[h2]In-Game Notifications[/h2]
For too long have notifications of all kinds had been placed in the same location, sometimes covering each other up. Now the Celebrity Death, Flight Points collected, Intercom Usage, Medium Ability, and Goose Hunt Death alerts appear at the top of the screen so that they don't interfere with each other and you can be well informed.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/e215a41bcfa78877e33c4645ccf190093e1d8328.png"][/img]

[h2]Audio Input: Push to Mute[/h2]
Similar to Push to Talk, Push to Mute is simply that - push to mute. An alternative to having to toggle the Mute key. It mutes your mic on press and unmutes on release.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/fe062f9cdf3293ae343c6e60979e785198d066f5.png[/img]

[h2]Pet of the Week Icon[/h2]
The community talked, we listened. Now within the collections pet tab, we've added a calendar icon to indicate which pet is Pet of the Week.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/ba7bd1b11720657f1add480f7fd77bcf87c5c7f3.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Reports and Fixes[/h2]
[h3]General Tickets[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Consistent Terminology:[/b] [list][*] Updated "No Microphone" in Quickplay filters to "Voice Chat".[/list][/list][h3]Role Tickets[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Invisibility Duck[/b] [list][*] Fixed: Vulnerable to being killed/swallowed while invisible. [*]Fixed: Can't see corpses while invisible. [/list][*] [b]Looter Duck[/b] [list][*] Fixed: Disposing corpses in sinkholes reduces kill cooldown. [/list][*] [b]Mime Duck[/b] [list][*] Fixed: Ability movement with mouse is now easier to control. [*] Fixed: Movement is based off controlled player and not the Mime. [/list][*] [b]Ninja Duck[/b] [list][*] Fixed: Kill cooldown continues to go down during meetings. [/list][*] [b]Sniper Duck[/b] [list][*] Adjustment: Disabled on Nexus Colony. [*] Adjustment: Disabled on Ancient Sands. [/list][*] [b]Clown Duck[/b] [list][*] Fixed: Can't access vents. [*] Fixed: If target is cleansed in rejuvenation pod on Eagleton Springs, this is reflected to the Clown during meeting. [/list][*] [b]Party Duck[/b] [list][*] Fixed: If target is cleansed in rejuvenation pod on Eagleton Springs, this is reflected to the Party during meeting. [/list][*] [b]Hitman/Bodyguard[/b] [list][*] Fixed: Target revealed on opening splash screen. [*] Fixed: Dueling Dodos can't be VIP target. [/list][*] [b]Lovers[/b] [list][*] Adjustment: When assassinated in a meeting, shots are delayed rather than simultaneous. [/list][*] [b]Astral Goose[/b] [list][*] Fixed: No longer able to interact with objects (tasks, rollercoaster, etc.) while in astral form. [/list][*] [b]Avenger Goose[/b] [list][*] Fixed: Ability no longer activates through forbidden passageways. [/list][*] [b]Mortician Goose[/b] [list][*] Fixed: Returned to available roles. That's going to do it for this update note. Remember, if you come across any bugs or unintended features, please report them using the in-game bug report feature in Settings or fill out the [url="https://gagglestudios.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new"]online ticket form[/url].

notes.title: v3.16 Quickplay Overhaul
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/d15ab2ce16985fe687f5de930743d7bd3c5402ce.png[/img]

[h2][b]Quickplay Update[/b][/h2]

[u][b]We’ve streamlined Quickplay to help you jump into matches faster and with more control.[/b][/u]
Quickplay has been enhanced to get you into matches more efficiently. Simply choose your preferred settings, and Quickplay will automatically find a compatible lobby and place you directly into it. Less waiting, more playing.

[h3][b]How It Works[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Upon clicking the Quickplay selection, you'll have access to a variety of settings.[/*]
[*]Choose your preferred lobby parameters and language(s).[/*]
[*]You'll be placed in a queue to find your next game that best matches your preferences.[/*]
[*]The system will match you with existing lobbies that fit your criteria.[/*]
[/list]

[h2][b]Customization Before Starting a Match[/b][/h2]

Customize your player Cosmetics, Banner, Card, and name before jumping into games.
You can now access your Collection and preview your loadout from the game menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/5ca0d672693d6a5b57e794920c5585eeb6cba502.png[/img]

[h2][b]Improved Public Lobbies[/b][/h2]

You can now see [b]Level 25+ and 18+*[/b] tags clearly listed when browsing lobbies, making it faster to find games that meet your preferences.

[i]*Please Note: The 18+ tag is only an indicator set by the host that a lobby may be perceived as a more mature lobby. Please do not disclose your personal information. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/804ee49ef56ac2f832fb2fdccf6d7e0c73f3a9ce.png[/img]

[h2][b]Explore Mode Enhancements[/b][/h2]

Players can now enter [b]Explore Mode with their cosmetics visible[/b], so whether you're testing tasks, scouting maps, or just poking around, you’ll do it in style.

[h2][b]New Lobby Makeover[/b][/h2]

The Lobby just got a makeover! Here’s what’s new:
[list]
[*][b]Fresh Layout –[/b] Room Name and Code now proudly displayed at the top of the screen for easy access.[/*]
[*][b]Play or Spectate –[/b] Switch between Play and Spectate mode with a single click.[/*]
[*][b]Ready Up! –[/b] Tap the Ready? button when you're set, and you're good to go![/*]
[*][b]Chat Popups –[/b] Chat messages now briefly appear on screen for better visibility. You can toggle this feature On/Off in the Settings panel (it’s On by default).[/*]
[*][b]Chat Window Revamp -[/b] The Chat Window has a fresh new look! Player Cards now appear alongside each goose’s image, making it easier than ever to see who’s talking.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: v3.04 Hoot & Seek!
notes.content:

[h1]Introducing Hoot & Seek[/h1]
Round up your flock of friends (2-5 players) and embark into a game of Hoot and Seek! As the Owl, you'll be able to blend in seamlessly with the crowd. But beware, those pesky Snipers and Spotters are on a mission to expose your feathery whereabouts!
[h2]Game Mode Description[/h2]
The Owl must blend in with NPCs to complete tasks to win the game. Spotters and Snipers work together to identify and kill the Owl to win.
[h2]Roles[/h2]
[h3]Sniper[/h3]
Snipers are the only ones that can shoot the Owl, and rely on information from the Spotters to find their target.
Abilities
[list]
[*] Targeting: Enter targeting mode. Temporarily stop moving and control the crosshair to search for the Owl.
[*] Exit targeting mode.
[*] Shoot: Snipers can shoot to kill the Owl. Make sure not to shoot randomly, as any incorrect kill will reward tasks to the Owl and reveal the Sniper's location on the map.
[/list]
[h3]Spotter[/h3]
Spotters help the Snipers to locate the Owl, but be aware that the Owl can also hear all communication.
Abilities
[list]
[*] Scan: Scan an area for the Owl's presence. A green circle will show if the Owl is in proximity, and a red circle if they are not.
[/list]
[h3]Owl[/h3]
The Owl is visually indistinguishable from the NPCs in the game. They win by stealthily completing tasks and avoiding detection from the Snipers and Spotters.
Abilities
[list]
[*] Disguise: Select a target to disguise as. Can disguise itself by first selecting another player's appearance.
[*] Transform: Transform into your selected target.
[*] Pickpocket: The Owl can pickpocket Snipers to complete several tasks at once and to reduce the cooldown of their abilities.
[*] Blackout: Temporarily reduce the vision of all other players and move faster.
[*] Super Reset: Randomize the cosmetics and positions of all players. It has a very high cooldown, so make sure to only use it in case of emergency.
[/list]
[h1]Role Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Demolitionist (Duck):[/b] Bomb is now passed automatically by proximity, no longer passed by action button.
[*][b]Party (Duck):[/b] Partied players now display an icon next to their name during game play. Only revealed to the Party (Duck).
[*][b]Silencer (Duck):[/b] Silenced players now display an icon next to their name during game play. Only revealed to the Silencer (Duck).
[*][b]Pigeon (Neutral):[/b] Infected geese now show an infected icon next to their names, to help keep track of the infected. Only revealed to the Pigeon.
[*][b]Astral (Goose):[/b] Now togglable into Astral form, and has infinite time.
[/list]
[h1]Quickplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] Hoot & Seek has been added to Quickplay.
[*] Select game mode tabs have been merged.
[/list]
[h1]Voice Chat[/h1]
With the last voice chat update we aimed to improve voice chat for everyone, although the quality was better, it led to less accessibility. We've been looking at ways to mitigate this problem and have implemented changes that should solve the problem for most users. We are still working actively and diligently alongside our third-party providers to find a solution. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience as we work through this with these updates.

This means the Corruption mechanic (and the roles associated with it) have been removed from Bloodhaven in Classic game mode and has been added to its own game mode: Corruption!

This gives players the option to enjoy Bloodhaven with or without the corruption mechanic. 
This also opens up the potential to add the Corruption game mode to other existing maps as well as new maps in the future while still being able to provide the Classic game mode experience to players.

Various bug fixes and optimizations.

notes.title: 10/01/2023 Update
notes.content:
Our success has been incredible, and I want to thank all our players once again. We underwent a massive attack this morning and subsequently took our servers down to maintain and reinforce them. None of your data was compromised.

We’ve been undergoing attacks for approximately two months now. We’ve mentioned it once mid-December, but we made a decision to avoid mentioning it further so as to not alarm players. The combination of the attack and our high player numbers (600 thousand CCU’s) left us vulnerable.
We have hired very talented cybersecurity specialists to help us. We don’t want to say much beyond this, because we don’t want to expose specific ways in which we are trying to safeguard ourselves. 
Our plan is to come back on Wednesday at 5 PM EST. We want to do the best that we can to secure as much as possible, instead of rushing back tonight. We will keep everyone posted if anything changes.

I want to thank all our players for their patience and understanding during this time. We are doing everything that we can. We are very grateful for our community’s support.
